title: workspace-bar project file
description: <main worktree>/.local/workspace-bar.json: the endpoints shown in the menu for each worktree. Strings may use ${ports.<name>}, ${worktree} and ${branch}.

name.description: Project name shown in the menu. Defaults to the main worktree's folder name.

id.description: Stable id used by clicks. Defaults to a slug of the label.

port.description: Port watched for the status dot: an AlignFirst port name, or a number. Deduced from a local URL otherwise.

secret.description: Marks a copy value as a secret (default true for copy).

open.description: URL opened by macOS (browser, TablePlus for postgres://, …), or by `app`.

claude.description: Starts Claude Code in Terminal on the worktree.

run.description: Absolute executable path then its arguments, run in the worktree without a shell.
